def choose_move(observation):
    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position", [0, 0])
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    dx, dy = 0, 0

    def sign(n):
        return 1 if n > 0 else -1 if n < 0 else 0

    # Defensive access
    role = observation.get("self_role")
    role = role if role is not None else "pursuer"

    def get_target(targets):
        if not targets:
            return None
        return min(targets, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - sx) + abs(c[1] - sy))

    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", [sx, sy])
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0 if ox == sx else sign(ox - sx)
            dy = 0 if oy == sy else sign(oy - sy)
            return [dx, dy]
        else:
            corners = [
                [0, 0],
                [0, max(0, observation.get("grid_height",1)-1)],
                [max(0, observation.get("grid_width",1)-1), 0],
                [max(0, observation.get("grid_width",1)-1), max(0, observation.get("grid_height",1)-1)]
            ]
            ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", [sx, sy])
            target = get_target(corners)
            if target:
                dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else sign(target[0] - sx)
                dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else sign(target[1] - sy)
            return [dx, dy]

    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or observation.get("opponent_territory") or []
        target = get_target(targets)
        if target:
            dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else sign(target[0] - sx)
            dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else sign(target[1] - sy)
            return [dx, dy]
        else:
            return [0, 0]

    resources = observation.get("resources") or []
    resource = get_target(resources)
    if resource:
        dx = 0 if resource[0] == sx else sign(resource[0] - sx)
        dy = 0 if resource[1] == sy else sign(resource[1] - sy)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Default move: towards opponent or center
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", [sx, sy])
    dx = 0 if ox == sx else sign(ox - sx)
    dy = 0 if oy == sy else sign(oy - sy)
    return [dx, dy]
